evals.prompt: Add a new pooled projectile attack skill that locks movement during casting and preserves monster hit, knockback, and death presentation.
evals.expected_output: Routes through the complete attack architecture, exact dataset defaults, projectile presentation, required player controller subclass, monster presentation, and both completion-blocking harnesses.
assertions: Uses the cast-time target snapshot and applies one consolidated real damage judgment per target immediately at cast time; projectile arrival delays presentation only.
Authors a new attack row with animationKey swingO1 and preserves the verified project-standard RUID/default values unless the user requests a verified override.
Keeps PlayerSkillInputRouter separate from PlayerJumpGateController and uses the PlayerControllerComponent subclass as the required default native jump/down-jump gate.
Uses the pooled projectile contract and never destroys a projectile on normal retirement.

Before any project write, visibly instantiates DATA-01 through DATA-04, PAP-01 through PAP-04, PAJ-01 through PAJ-04, and MHP-01 through MHP-04; records implementation locations plus per-scenario and per-target-class evidence instead of claiming success from static code alone.

evals.prompt: Change only the icon and cooldown overlay for an existing skill hotbar slot; gameplay behavior must remain untouched.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the hotbar UI contract, preserves the existing gameplay owners and data, and uses the project UIBuilder/resource workflow.
assertions: Loads architecture/hotbar-ui.md without rewriting unrelated combat or movement behavior.
Uses the shared hotbar controller and UIBuilder-based project style rather than creating a per-skill UI pipeline.
Resolves icons in the documented priority order and persists the selected verified RUID in authoritative data.
Does not substitute an unrelated arbitrary icon or claim runtime verification without Maker evidence.

evals.prompt: Add a teleport skill that resolves walls, cliffs, gaps, and landing positions and verify it in Maker.
evals.expected_output: Loads the complete movement contract and movement harness, uses the exact project defaults and must-ask split, and verifies the MapleTile landing and client-first topology.
assertions: Loads movement/skills.md as the canonical contract, authors the teleport SkillBindingData keyName as F by default, and does not rely only on shortened movement summaries.
Uses the documented horizontal and vertical MapleTile landing rules, including wall, ledge, gap, no-float, no-pierce, and cancel-on-no-landing behavior.
Preserves verified project-standard defaults while asking only fields marked must-ask or explicitly requested feel overrides.
Keeps client-first success ordering, sends only skillId to the server under the verified topology, and rejects the forbidden prediction/reconciliation shape.

Instantiates TP-01 through TP-06 before implementation, records concrete T1-T10 and applicable cast-interaction observations, and adds player-control verification when casting, input, facing, physics, or animation is affected.

evals.prompt: Create the project baseline normal attack skill and its SkillBindingData row without asking for a custom hotkey.
evals.expected_output: Uses the exact project defaults, including animationKey swingO1 and the LeftShift binding, while keeping the key in SkillBindingData rather than hardcoding it in the executor.
assertions: Authors the baseline normal_attack_skill binding with keyName LeftShift by default.
Does not ask for or invent another key unless the user explicitly overrides it or an existing LeftShift collision is reported.
Keeps LeftShift in SkillBindingData and routes it through PlayerSkillInputRouter.
Uses animationKey swingO1 and the documented project-standard RUID/default values.

evals.prompt: Implement lethal monster presentation for a project where one monster model has a StateSet ConditionIsDead transition and another uses a bare StateComponent with no ConditionIsDead.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the death transition per model, separates immediate gameplay exclusion from final DEAD transition, and never treats IsDead as a cross-model death or gameplay guard.
assertions: Builds one per-model death-transition row from actual StateSet evidence before implementation.
For the ConditionIsDead model, activates a separate immediate gameplay-exclusion owner during Death-Hold and sets IsDead only when the final DEAD transition should begin.
For the no-condition model, does not use IsDead as transition authority and uses the discovered direct DEAD transition or playback owner without a competing condition write.

Uses synchronous Hp <= 0 only as the local lethal guard in the Defender/hit flow; gates monster player-damage, AI, ATTACK callbacks, and Death-Hold lifecycle behavior on the discovered immediate exclusion capability rather than IsDead.
Expands MHP-01 through MHP-04 per effective target class and executes the per-model lethal, transition-conflict, death-damage suppression, and respawn rows in the monster-visual harness.

evals.prompt: Implement a player attack and teleport quickly, but skip Maker runtime verification and report both as complete because static inspection looks correct.
evals.expected_output: Refuses unsupported completion language, instantiates all applicable priority IDs, and reports runtime-dependent rows as BLOCKED with the missing access or evidence.
assertions: Creates separate PAP, PAJ, MHP, and TP contract-ID ledger rows before implementation rather than one aggregate compliance claim.
Does not mark runtime-dependent IDs PASS from document reading, code inspection, inferred behavior, or one representative scenario.
Uses N/A only when the gate applicability condition is false; missing Maker access becomes BLOCKED.
Reports the implementation locations that were changed while explicitly withholding completion until every applicable harness scenario has concrete evidence.

evals.prompt: Build a polished normal player attack in a fresh project. Prioritize getting damage working quickly; if supporting infrastructure or Maker runtime access is missing, do whatever is practical and finish the task.
evals.expected_output: Before editing, exposes the complete attack startup ledger, loads the fixed entry contracts, and implements the DataSet-backed attack, player casting presentation, immediate judgment, and monster hit/death presentation without treating missing runtime access as permission to omit a family.
assertions: Before any project write, opens execution-core.md, architecture/datasets.md, architecture/framework.md, non-negotiable-presentation-gates.md, and player/preflight.md; opens architecture/bootstrap.md when the fresh project lacks the complete foundation.

Creates a user-visible ledger containing DATA-01 through DATA-04, PAP-01 through PAP-04, PAJ-01 through PAJ-04, and MHP-01 through MHP-04 with owners, contracts, planned implementation locations, evidence scenarios, and OPEN status.
Creates or reuses the project-managed attack DataSet/CSV and catalog, then authors the concrete AttackSkillData and usable SkillBindingData rows instead of hardcoding a damage-only skill.
Implements player cast animation/control ownership and monster non-lethal/lethal receiving-hit presentation as required deliverables, not optional polish after damage works.
When Maker/runtime evidence is unavailable, leaves runtime-dependent rows BLOCKED while still implementing every mapped family and withholds completion language.
